Update both.\" | user must update |\n| `E-META-BOUNDS` | Beacon field out of bounds (T1) | \"That transmission looks malformed and was rejected.\" | automatic, refuse |\n| `E-MANIFEST-CORRUPT` | Manifest CRC validation failed (§7.6) | \"The block manifest is corrupted and is being re-decoded.\" | automatic retry |\n| `E-MANIFEST-MISSING` | Manifest never arrived (§7.6) | \"Waiting for block manifest to verify received chunks.\" | wait or request repair |\n| `E-MANIFEST-DECODE` | Manifest fountain decode failed (§7.6) | \"Could not decode the block manifest. Retrying...\" | automatic retry |\n| `E-MANIFEST-LIVELOCK` | E12 livelock detected, manifest corrupted (bf-5fm) | \"Multiple chunks failed verification — the manifest appears corrupted. 1; y++) {\n      for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x++) {\n        const i = (y * width + x) * 4;\n        const center = data[i];\n        const top = data[i - width * 4];\n        const bottom = data[i + width * 4];\n        const left = data[i - 4];\n        const right = data[i + 4];\n\n        const laplacian = 4 * center - top - bottom - left - right;\n        sum += laplacian * laplacian;\n        count++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return count > 0 ? sum / count : undefined;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('[QR Decode Worker] Failed to calculate sharpness:', error);\n    return undefined;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Check for torn frame damage (rolling shutter mismatch).\n *\n * Detects inconsistencies in brightness that might indicate the frame\n * was captured while the display was still updating.\n */\nfunction detectTornFrame(imageData: ImageData): boolean {\n  try {\n    const { width, height, data } = imageData;\n\n    // Sample brightness across horizontal bands\n    const bands = 5;\n    const bandHeight = Math.floor(height / bands);\n    const brightnesses: number[] = [];\n\n    for (let b = 0; b < bands; b++) {\n      let sum = 0;\n      let count = 0;\n      const startY = b * bandHeight;\n      const endY = Math.min(startY + bandHeight, height);\n\n      for (let y = startY; y < endY; y++) {\n        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {\n          const i = (y * width + x) * 4;\n          sum += data[i]; // Red channel\n          sum += data[i + 1]; // Green channel\n          sum += data[i + 2]; // Blue channel\n          count += 3;\n        }\n      }\n\n      brightnesses.push(count > 0 ? sum / count : 0);\n    }\n\n    // Check for significant variation (>30% difference between bands)\n    const max = Math.max(...brightnesses);\n    const min = Math.min(...brightnesses);\n    const variation = max > 0 ? 1; y++) {\n      for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x++) {\n        const i = (y * width + x) * 4;\n        const center = data[i];\n        const top = data[i - width * 4];\n        const bottom = data[i + width * 4];\n        const left = data[i - 4];\n        const right = data[i + 4];\n\n        const laplacian = 4 * center - top - bottom - left - right;\n        sum += laplacian * laplacian;\n        count++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return count > 0 ? sum / count : undefined;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.warn('[QR Decode Worker] Failed to calculate sharpness:', error);\n    return undefined;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Check for torn frame damage (rolling shutter mismatch).\n *\n * Detects inconsistencies in brightness that might indicate the frame\n * was captured while the display was still updating.\n */\nfunction detectTornFrame(imageData: ImageData): boolean {\n  try {\n    const { width, height, data } = imageData;\n\n    // Sample brightness across horizontal bands\n    const bands = 5;\n    const bandHeight = Math.floor(height / bands);\n    const brightnesses: number[] = [];\n\n    for (let b = 0; b < bands; b++) {\n      let sum = 0;\n      let count = 0;\n      const startY = b * bandHeight;\n      const endY = Math.min(startY + bandHeight, height);\n\n      for (let y = startY; y < endY; y++) {\n        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {\n          const i = (y * width + x) * 4;\n          sum += data[i]; // Red channel\n          sum += data[i + 1]; // Green channel\n          sum += data[i + 2]; // Blue channel\n          count += 3;\n        }\n      }\n\n      brightnesses.push(count > 0 ? sum / count : 0);\n    }\n\n    // Check for significant variation (>30% difference between bands)\n    const max = Math.max(...brightnesses);\n    const min = Math.min(...brightnesses);\n    const variation = max > 0 ?
